vulkan_raw_log_capture: Retained directly from the running CTest process original log inode with a read-only descriptor after a show-only metadata query replaced the conventional LastTest path. Test execution and the separately redirected CTest summary were unaffected.
counting: ASan/UBSan use INTRINSIC_GROUP_PURE_CTEST=ON, so their CTest entry counts include grouped executables and are not directly comparable to the ungrouped CPU/GPU count.
source_binding: See source-provenance.json, retained corpus source.patch, post-corpus-source-binding.json and post-corpus-ui-test.patch.gz. Only the additional GPU workspace test differs after the numerical/CPU/ASan runs.
resource_policy: One build/corpus at a time under flock, compiler parallelism at most two, cgroup MemoryHigh16G/MemoryMax24G/MemorySwapMax1G; sanitizer CTest serial.
visual_capture: Separate GDB diagnostic after the normal Vulkan gate; ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0 only in this debugger run because LSan cannot run under ptrace. It is visual evidence, not sanitizer verification.
